searchText: I'm on the EthereumJS team and working on implementing the `NEW_BLOCK` message in our client and have a question about the block propagation spec as it applies to this message. https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/blob/master/caps/eth.md#block-propagation Here in the spec, it says to just validate the PoW in the header of the block received from a peer, propagate that to a subset of all connected peers, and then actually process the block, insert into the local chain, and only then broadcast `NEW_BLOCK_HASHES` after the block is fully processed. Is there a reason for splitting up the PoW validation before re-broadcasting `NEW_BLOCK` from block processing and broadcasting `NEW_BLOCK_HASHES`? Yes block processing takes quite a long time so we like to broadcast the block as fast as possible Thus we only check the PoW to be "reasonably sure" that the block is somewhat valid makes sense, thanks!
